name: pioneer
description: Delegate sandboxed code reviews to a locally installed Pi coding agent.

interface.shortDescription: Run local Pi code reviews from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Ask a locally installed and configured Pi coding agent to review code with a selected provider model and thinking level. macOS and Linux reviews run inside a native operating-system sandbox.
defaultPrompt: Ask Pi to review the current repository.
Have Pi review these changes using max thinking.
List my configured Pi models before reviewing.
